Thus exactly 2^(k-1) pair collisions. Reversal closure holds by reflection through a sufficiently large power of two. Even-length palindrome impossibility for k>=2 gives r=rho/2; k=1 has unique 00 palindrome. The standalone verifier exhaustively checks 56 (m,k) template configurations and 20 independent finite-prefix factor sets.
